entries.title: This War of Mine
entries.definitive_edition: This War of Mine Final Cut / Complete Edition route on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Final Cut / Complete Edition route with Stories DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route has Final Cut, the full DLC/Stories path, and the best mouse/keyboard and capture setup. Switch Complete Edition and current-gen Final Cut are valid routes, but PC remains the most flexible archival version.
primary.how_to_play: Buy This War of Mine on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or the official 11 bit route for Windows PC; use Final Cut plus This War of Mine: Stories DLC for the complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Final Cut and Stories DLC route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC has the Final Cut/current complete route and the best capture/input path. Switch Complete and current-gen Final Cut are good alternates but do not add exclusive story content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Final Cut is the polished/current edition. This War of Mine: The Little Ones and Complete Edition are content/edition routes, and the board game is not a video-game entry.
